literature.headline_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人乳头瘤病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 本研究旨在识别用于 primary 治疗 分层的患者群体,建立纵向生物样本库,并确定复发的生物学机制,研究结果将通过同行评审的出版物、会议报告和科学会议进行传播。 [10.1136/bmjopen-2026-121924]
仅有32.1%(80/249)的照顾者听说过HPV,更少的人了解其与宫颈癌(24.4%,60/246)或预防方法(31.9%,79/248)之间的关联。存在普遍的误解,其中16.3%(36/221)的照顾者错误地将口服避孕药与宫颈癌联系起来,而61.1%(44/72)不愿接种疫苗的照顾者则表示对疫苗有效性的不信任。 [10.64898/2026.09.21.26363609]
HPV疫苗接种的促进因素包括学校为基础的计划的便利性、将疫苗与其他常规疫苗一同推广、与学校、父母/监护人和社区建立关系、包含个人故事的信息传播以及青少年参与。 [10.17269/s41997-026-01250-6]

新鲜P. scutellaria的乙醇提取物在所有测试提取物中对野生型和药物耐受型HSV株表现出最强的抑制作用,并下调了HSV-1的ICP4、UL30、US6和gC。该提取物还抑制了HPV-16假病毒在早期阶段的感染。此外,它减少了癌细胞增殖并增加了细胞凋亡,同时抑制了HPV-16/18 E6、BCL2和NFKB1的表达,上调了BAX的表达。 [10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199808]
观察组的总有效率高于对照组(89.47% vs. 72.06%,p = 0.015),且首次HPV转阴时间更短(P = 0.028),但总体四类HPV结果分布(P = 0.060)和HPV16/18特异性转阴率(P = 0.138)无显著差异。 [10.3791/72664]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: The study aims to identify patient populations for primary treatment stratification, establish a longitudinal biorepository, and determine biological mechanisms of recurrence, with findings to be disseminated through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, and scientific meetings. [10.1136/bmjopen-2026-121924]

From August 2017 to October 2025, 1056 AEFI cases were reported, with an overall rate of 7.99 per 100,000 doses. Of these, 1008 cases (95.46%) were mild vaccine-related reactions, and 15 cases (1.42%) were rare adverse reactions. [10.1080/21645515.2026.2731696]
Only 32.1% (80/249) of caregivers had heard of HPV, and fewer were aware of its link to cervical cancer (24.4%, 60/246) or prevention methods (31.9%, 79/248). [10.64898/2026.09.21.26363609]

Enablers of HPV immunization included convenience of the school-based program, normalization of the vaccine alongside other routine vaccines, relationship building with schools, parents/guardians, and communities, messaging that included personal stories, and youth engagement. [10.17269/s41997-026-01250-6]

The ethanolic extract of fresh P. scutellaria exhibited the strongest inhibitory effects against both wild-type and drug-resistant HSV strains among all extracts tested and downregulated HSV-1 ICP4, UL30, US6 and gC. This extract also suppressed HPV-16 pseudovirus infection at an early stage. [10.1016/j.virusres.2026.199808]
literature.trend_or_risk_en: The direction of this week's research is defined by the clinical, epidemiological, ecological, diagnostic and molecular topics actually represented by the eligible publications.

papers.title: Multimodality detection of early relapse in radically treated high-risk HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: study protocol for a prospective multicentre UK cohort study (HERD).
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is the seventh most common cancer globally, with over 12 000 new cases annually in the UK. Despite aggressive radical treatment, approximately 50% of patients with locally advanced (stage III/IV), human papilloma virus (HPV)-negative disease relapse within 2 years, often in the first year. Although current post-treatment follow-up schedules are recommended by clinical guidelines, imaging surveillance is led by symptoms after the initial 3 months and reliable biomarkers for early relapse are lacking. Consequently, recurrences are frequently detected too late for surgical salvage, though timely surgery can improve survival by up to 73% in selected cases. Head and Neck Early Relapse Detection Study represents a large-scale, prospective effort to integrate imaging, genomic, immunologic and microbiome datasets for relapse risk stratification and post-treatment surveillance in this high-risk patient group. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: Design: Prospective, observational cohort study. SETTING: Secondary and tertiary NHS hospitals in the UK. PARTICIPANTS: Recruiting up to 200 patients with stage III/IV (high-risk) HPV-negative HNSCC. Participants are enrolled into discovery (n=100) and validation (n=100) cohorts. Patients with HPV-positive tumours, metastatic disease or other contraindications defined in the protocol will be excluded. INTERVENTIONS: Observational study with no experimental intervention. Participants are followed for 2 years with longitudinal collection of blood, saliva, urine, stool, fresh and archival tumour tissue and advanced MRI where possible in addition to their standard of clinical care. PRIMARY OUTCOMES: Development and independent validation of a multimodal recurrence risk prediction model. SECONDARY OUTCOMES: Identifying patient populations for primary treatment stratification, establishment of a longitudinal biorepository and identifying biological mechanisms of recurrence. Multimodal data will be integrated using machine learning and Bayesian modelling. ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: Ethical approval was granted by the Bromley Research Ethics Committee (21/PR/1581). Findings will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations and scientific meetings. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT05097625.

papers.abstract_zh: INTRODUCTION: 头颈鳞状细胞癌(HNSCC)是全球第七常见的癌症,每年在英国约有超过12,000例新发病例。尽管采用积极的 radical 治疗 治疗,约50%的局部晚期(III/IV期)人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)阴性患者在2年内复发,通常在第一年内。虽然目前的 post-治疗 随访计划已被临床指南推荐,但影像学 监测 主要依赖于症状在初始3个月后进行,且缺乏可靠的早期复发生物标志物。因此,复发常被发现得太晚,无法进行手术挽救,尽管在某些情况下及时手术可将生存率提高多达73%。Head and Neck Early Relapse Detection Study 是一项大规模的前瞻性研究,旨在整合影像学、基因组学、免疫学和微生物组数据集,以对这一高风险患者群体进行复发风险分层和 post-治疗 监测。METHODS AND ANALYSIS: 设计:前瞻性、观察性 队列研究 研究。SETTING: 英国的二级和三级 NHS 医院。PARTICIPANTS: 招募最多200名 III/IV期(高风险)HPV 阴性 HNSCC 患者。参与者将被纳入发现组(n=100)和验证组(n=100)。患有 HPV 阳性肿瘤、转移性疾病或其他在方案中定义的禁忌症的患者将被排除。INTERVENTIONS: 观察性研究,无实验干预。参与者将在2年内接受随访,纵向收集血液、唾液、尿液、粪便、新鲜和存档肿瘤组织以及尽可能进行的先进MRI,同时继续其标准临床护理。PRIMARY OUTCOMES: 开发并独立验证多模态复发风险预测模型。SECONDARY OUTCOMES: 识别用于 primary 治疗 分层的患者群体,建立纵向生物样本库,并确定复发的生物学机制。多模态数据将通过机器学习和贝叶斯建模进行整合。ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: 伦理批准由 Bromley 研究伦理委员会(21/PR/1581)授予。研究结果将通过同行评审的出版物、会议报告和科学会议进行传播。TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT05097625.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决对 高危型HPV 阴性头颈鳞状细胞癌(HNSCC)患者早期复发的可靠生物标志物的需求,鉴于其高复发率以及当前 post-治疗 监测 的局限性。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项前瞻性、观察性 队列研究 研究,涉及英国二级和三级 NHS 医院最多200名 III/IV期 HPV 阴性 HNSCC 患者,重点是开发和验证多模态复发风险预测模型。
analysis_zh.methods: 本研究将通过机器学习和贝叶斯建模整合影像学、基因组学、免疫学和微生物组数据集,以开发复发风险预测模型。
analysis_zh.main_results: 本研究旨在识别用于 primary 治疗 分层的患者群体,建立纵向生物样本库,并确定复发的生物学机制,研究结果将通过同行评审的出版物、会议报告和科学会议进行传播。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究的创新之处在于整合多种数据模态,以提高 高危型HPV 阴性 HNSCC 患者复发风险预测和分层的准确性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可能有助于更有效的 post-治疗 监测,并实现患者分层,从而潜在地提高生存率,使及时的手术干预成为可能。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括缺乏随机化以及可能存在的混杂因素,但其设计旨在为复发风险预测和患者分层提供有价值的见解。

papers.title: Predicting parental Human papillomavirus vaccine hesitancy: development and internal validation of machine learning models
papers.abstract: Abstract Objectives Cervical cancer is Cameroon’s second most common cancer among women. However, high parental Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine hesitancy impedes elimination, and no validated predictive tool exists. This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy in the Buea Health District and identify key predictors. Methods This secondary analysis used cross-sectional survey data from 1,156 parents of children aged 9–18 years. Hesitancy was derived from self-reported vaccination status and intention. Twenty-six predictor groups were screened via group LASSO (17 retained for logistic regression; all 26 for tree-based models). Data were split 80/20 into training (n=925) and test (n=231) sets. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost were tuned via repeated cross-validation while thresholds were set by Youden’s J statistic. Discrimination, calibration, and Brier score were assessed on the test set. Predictions were interpreted using SHAP. Results All models showed comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870). XGBoost had the highest AUC (0.870, vs 0.869 for logistic regression, DeLong p=0.965); logistic regression had the highest sensitivity (73.1%), F1-score (74.9%), and lowest Brier score (0.1435). Calibration slopes exceeded 1 (1.12–1.46) across models. Insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety, and distrust in the Ministry of Health were the dominant predictors. Discussion The three models achieved comparable, clinically meaningful discrimination, and algorithmic complexity did not improve prediction over standard regression. Hesitancy was more strongly predicted by information access and institutional trust than sociodemographic disadvantage. Conclusion These findings support trust-building engagement over broad demographic campaigns. What is already known on this topic Parental HPV vaccine hesitancy is a major barrier to HPV vaccination, but predictive modelling evidence from sub-Saharan Africa is limited and no internally validated model for parental HPV vaccine hesitancy has been developed in the region. What this study adds We developed and internally validated logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost models for predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy, with all three showing comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870) and logistic regression achieving the lowest Brier score and highest sensitivity and F1-score. Insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety and distrust in the Ministry of Health were the dominant predictors across the models and interpretability analyses. How this study might affect research, practice or policy The findings support the development and external validation of simple, interpretable prediction tools to identify parents who may benefit from targeted, trust-building vaccine communication and community engagement to support HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention.

However, high parental Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine hesitancy impedes elimination, and no validated predictive tool exists. This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy in the Buea Health District and identify key predictors. Methods This secondary analysis used cross-sectional survey data from 1,156 parents of children aged 9–18 years. Hesitancy was derived from self-reported vaccination status and intention. Twenty-six predictor groups were screened via group LASSO (17 retained for logistic regression; all 26 for tree-based models). Data were split 80/20 into training (n=925) and test (n=231) sets. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost were tuned via repeated cross-validation while thresholds were set by Youden’s J statistic. Discrimination, calibration, and Brier score were assessed on the test set. Predictions were interpreted using SHAP. Results All models showed comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870). XGBoost had the highest AUC (0.870, vs 0.869 for logistic regression, DeLong p=0.965); logistic regression had the highest sensitivity (73.1%), F1-score (74.9%), and lowest Brier score (0.1435). Calibration slopes exceeded 1 (1.12–1.46) across models. Insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety, and distrust in the Ministry of Health were the dominant predictors. Discussion The three models achieved comparable, clinically meaningful discrimination, and algorithmic complexity did not improve prediction over standard regression. Hesitancy was more strongly predicted by information access and institutional trust than sociodemographic disadvantage. Conclusion These findings support trust-building engagement over broad demographic campaigns. What is already known on this topic Parental HPV vaccine hesitancy is a major barrier to HPV vaccination, but predictive modelling evidence from sub-Saharan Africa is limited and no internally validated model for parental HPV vaccine hesitancy has been developed in the region. What this study adds We developed and internally validated logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost models for predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy, with all three showing comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870) and logistic regression achieving the lowest Brier score and highest sensitivity and F1-score. Insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety and distrust in the Ministry of Health were the dominant predictors across the models and interpretability analyses. How this study might affect research, practice or policy The findings support the development and external validation of simple, interpretable prediction tools to identify parents who may benefit from targeted, trust-building vaccine communication and community engagement to support HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models to predict parental HPV vaccine hesitancy in the Buea Health District. The researchers used cross-sectional survey data from 1,156 parents of children aged 9–18 years, screening 26 predictor groups and tuning three models: logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. All models showed comparable discrimination, with XGBoost achieving the highest AUC and logistic regression showing the highest sensitivity and F1-score. The dominant predictors of hesitancy were insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety, and distrust in the Ministry of Health. The authors concluded that trust-building engagement is more effective than broad demographic campaigns in addressing vaccine hesitancy. The findings suggest the potential for developing simple, interpretable prediction tools to support targeted communication and community engagement for HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention. However, the study found that algorithmic complexity did not improve prediction over standard regression, indicating that simpler models may be sufficient. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the study's design and the absence of external validation.

papers.title_zh: 预测父母对人乳头瘤病毒疫苗接种犹豫:开发和内部验证机器学习模型
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Objectives Cervical cancer is Cameroon’s second most common cancer among women. However, high parental Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine hesitancy impedes elimination, and no validated predictive tool exists. This study aimed to develop and internally validate machine learning models predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy in the Buea Health District and identify key predictors. Methods This secondary analysis used cross-sectional survey data from 1,156 parents of children aged 9–18 years. Hesitancy was derived from self-reported vaccination status and intention. Twenty-six predictor groups were screened via group LASSO (17 retained for logistic regression; all 26 for tree-based models). Data were split 80/20 into training (n=925) and test (n=231) sets. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost were tuned via repeated cross-validation while thresholds were set by Youden’s J statistic. Discrimination, calibration, and Brier score were assessed on the test set. Predictions were interpreted using SHAP. Results All models showed comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870). XGBoost had the highest AUC (0.870, vs 0.869 for logistic regression, DeLong p=0.965); logistic regression had the highest sensitivity (73.1%), F1-score (74.9%), and lowest Brier score (0.1435). Calibration slopes exceeded 1 (1.12–1.46) across models. Insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety, and distrust in the Ministry of Health were the dominant predictors. Discussion The three models achieved comparable, clinically meaningful discrimination, and algorithmic complexity did not improve prediction over standard regression. Hesitancy was more strongly predicted by information access and institutional trust than sociodemographic disadvantage. Conclusion These findings support trust-building engagement over broad demographic campaigns. What is already known on this topic Parental HPV vaccine hesitancy is a major barrier to HPV vaccination, but predictive modelling evidence from sub-Saharan Africa is limited and no internally validated model for parental HPV vaccine hesitancy has been developed in the region. What this study adds We developed and internally validated logistic regression, random forest and XGBoost models for predicting parental HPV vaccine hesitancy, with all three showing comparable discrimination (AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870) and logistic regression achieving the lowest Brier score and highest sensitivity and F1-score. Insufficient vaccine information, perceived vaccine unsafety and distrust in the Ministry of Health were the dominant predictors across the models and interpretability analyses. How this study might affect research, practice or policy The findings support the development and external validation of simple, interpretable prediction tools to identify parents who may benefit from targeted, trust-building vaccine communication and community engagement to support HPV vaccination and cervical cancer prevention.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种是喀麦隆女性中第二常见的癌症。然而,高程度的父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫阻碍了消除进程,且目前尚无经过验证的预测工具。本研究旨在开发并内部验证用于预测Buea卫生区父母对HPV疫苗接种犹豫的机器学习模型,并确定关键预测因素。方法 本研究采用二次分析方法,使用了来自1,156名9至18岁儿童父母的横断面调查数据。犹豫程度来源于自我报告的疫苗接种状态和意愿。通过组LASSO筛选了26个预测组(17个用于逻辑回归;26个用于树模型)。数据按80/20的比例分为训练集(n=925)和测试集(n=231)。逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型通过重复交叉验证进行调优,阈值由Youden’s J统计量设定。在测试集上评估了模型的区分度、校准度和Brier分数。使用SHAP对预测结果进行了解释。结果 所有模型的区分度均相当(AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870)。XGBoost的AUC最高(0.870,与逻辑回归的0.869相比,DeLong p=0.965);逻辑回归的敏感度最高(73.1%),F1分数最高(74.9%),且Brier分数最低(0.1435)。所有模型的校准斜率均超过1(1.12–1.46)。信息不足、对HPV疫苗接种的安全性感知不足以及对卫生部的不信任是主要的预测因素。讨论 三种模型均实现了相当且具有临床意义的区分度,算法复杂性并未在标准回归之上提高预测能力。犹豫程度更强烈地由信息获取和机构信任预测,而非社会人口学劣势。结论 这些发现支持通过建立信任的参与方式,而非广泛的人口学宣传活动,来应对父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫。已有知识 由于父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫是HPV疫苗接种的主要障碍,但撒哈拉以南非洲地区的预测建模证据有限,且该地区尚未开发出内部验证的父母对HPV疫苗接种犹豫预测模型。本研究的贡献 我们开发并内部验证了逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost模型,用于预测父母对HPV疫苗接种的犹豫。所有三种模型均显示出相当的区分度(AUC-ROC 0.841–0.870),其中逻辑回归实现了最低的Brier分数和最高的敏感度及F1分数。信息不足、对HPV疫苗接种的安全性感知不足以及对卫生部的不信任是所有模型和可解释性分析中的主要预测因素。对研究、实践或政策的潜在影响 这些发现支持开发和外部验证简单且可解释的预测工具,以识别可能从有针对性的信任建立HPV疫苗接种沟通和社区参与中受益的父母,从而支持HPV疫苗接种和宫颈癌预防。

papers.title: Retrospective Study of Wandai Decoction Plus Recombinant Human Interferon Alpha-2b in Persistent High-Risk Human Papillomavirus Infection.
papers.abstract: This retrospective study evaluated clinical outcomes associated with Wandai Decoction (WDT) plus recombinant human interferon α-2b (rhIFN-α-2b) in patients with persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection and a spleen-deficiency pattern, with particular attention to vaginal microecology and peripheral T-cell subsets. Clinical data from 125 patients treated between March 2024 and September 2025 were analyzed. According to the treatment regimen, 57 patients received oral WDT plus rhIFN-α-2b vaginal suppositories, whereas 68 patients received rhIFN-α-2b alone. Both groups received three consecutive treatment courses. After treatment, the observation group had a higher total effective rate than the control group (89.47% vs. 72.06%, p = 0.015) and a shorter time to first HPV conversion (P = 0.028), whereas the overall four-category HPV outcome distribution (P = 0.060) and HPV16/18-specific conversion rate (P = 0.138) did not differ significantly. More favorable vaginal microecological findings included lower pH, leukocyte esterase positivity, and amine test positivity, along with higher rates of normal hydrogen peroxide status, vaginal cleanliness grade I-II, and Lactobacillus predominance (P < 0.05). Fungal detection, bacterial vaginosis-related abnormalities, and mixed infection were also less frequent (P < 0.05). Post-treatment CD4+ T-cell percentage and the CD4+/CD8+ ratio were higher, whereas CD8+ T-cell percentage was lower, in the observation group (P < 0.05). The total traditional Chinese medicine syndrome score, abnormal cervical color, and contact bleeding also showed more favorable findings. The overall rate of recorded adverse events did not differ significantly between groups (P = 0.057). WDT plus rhIFN-α-2b was associated with more favorable HPV-related, vaginal microecological, peripheral T-cell subset, and symptom outcomes; however, the retrospective design and residual confounding preclude causal interpretation.

analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective study analyzed clinical data from 125 patients treated between March 2024 and September 2025, with 57 patients receiving WDT plus rhIFN-α-2b vaginal suppositories and 68 patients receiving rhIFN-α-2b alone.
analysis.methods: The study involved evaluating clinical outcomes through analysis of patient data, including HPV conversion rates, vaginal microecological parameters, peripheral T-cell subsets, and symptom improvements, with both groups receiving three consecutive treatment courses.
analysis.main_results: The observation group had a higher total effective rate (89.47% vs. 72.06%, p = 0.015) and a shorter time to first HPV conversion (P = 0.028) compared to the control group, while the overall four-category HPV outcome distribution (P = 0.060) and HPV16/18-specific conversion rate (P = 0.138) did not differ significantly.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that WDT plus rhIFN-α-2b may improve clinical outcomes in patients with persistent high-risk HPV infection, particularly in terms of HPV conversion and vaginal microecology, though the retrospective design limits causal conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study investigated the clinical outcomes of Wandai Decoction (WDT) plus recombinant human interferon α-2b (rhIFN-α-2b) in patients with persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection and a spleen-deficiency pattern. The study included 125 patients treated between March 2024 and September 2025, divided into two groups: one receiving WDT plus rhIFN-α-2b vaginal suppositories and the other receiving rhIFN-α-2b alone. Both groups underwent three consecutive treatment courses. The observation group showed a higher total effective rate (89.47% vs. 72.06%, p = 0.015) and a shorter time to first HPV conversion (P = 0.028) compared to the control group. However, the overall four-category HPV outcome distribution (P = 0.060) and HPV16/18-specific conversion rate (P = 0.138) did not differ significantly. More favorable vaginal microecological findings, including lower pH and higher rates of normal hydrogen peroxide status, were observed in the observation group. Post-treatment, CD4+ T-cell percentage and the CD4+/CD8+ ratio were higher, while CD8+ T-cell percentage was lower in the observation group. The study highlights potential benefits of WDT plus rhIFN-α-2b in managing persistent HR-HPV infection but emphasizes the limitations of the retrospective design and the need for further research to establish causality.

papers.abstract_zh: 本回顾性研究评估了万代汤(WDT)联合重组人干扰素α-2b(rhIFN-α-2b)在持续高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)感染且具有脾虚证型的患者中的临床结果,特别关注阴道微生态和外周T细胞亚群。分析了2024年3月至2025年9月期间接受治疗的125名患者的临床数据。根据治疗方案,57名患者接受了口服万代汤联合rhIFN-α-2b阴道栓剂治疗,而68名患者仅接受了rhIFN-α-2b治疗。两组患者均接受了三疗程的连续治疗。治疗后,观察组的总有效率高于对照组(89.47% vs. 72.06%,p = 0.015),且首次HPV转阴时间更短(P = 0.028),但总体四类HPV结果分布(P = 0.060)和HPV16/18特异性转阴率(P = 0.138)无显著差异。更有利的阴道微生态结果包括阴道pH值较低、白细胞酯酶阳性率和胺试验阳性率较低,以及正常过氧化氢状态比例和阴道清洁度I-II级比例较高,乳酸杆菌优势比例也较高(P < 0.05)。真菌检测、细菌性阴道病相关异常和混合感染的发生率也较低(P < 0.05)。治疗后,观察组的CD4+ T细胞百分比和CD4+/CD8+比值更高,而CD8+ T细胞百分比更低(P < 0.05)。总体中医证候积分、异常宫颈颜色和接触性出血等指标也显示出更有利的结果。两组记录的不良事件总体发生率无显著差异(P = 0.057)。万代汤联合rhIFN-α-2b与更优的HPV相关、阴道微生态、外周T细胞亚群和症状结果相关;然而,回顾性设计和残留混杂因素限制了因果解释的结论。

papers.title: Global policy determinants of national human papillomavirus vaccine introductions in 2006-2025.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Although safe and effective human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines have been available since 2006, national introduction in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) has progressed slowly. HPV vaccine adoption may have been shaped by evolving World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations, funding policies of Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, and the disruption from the Coronavirus Disease 2019 pandemic. However, their relative contributions have not been quantified. RESEARCH DESIGN AND METHODS: This study analyzed policy determinants of national HPV vaccine introduction rate in LMICs from 2006 to 2025, using: (i) generalized linear model (GLM) to assess predetermined policy events, and (ii) changepoint analysis to identify shifts in adoption trends. RESULTS: Across a range of GLMs exploring different events and outcome variables, WHO's one-dose recommendation in 2022 was most strongly associated with an increase in country introductions, with the expansion of Gavi's funding policy for HPV vaccines (2017-2025) also important in some models. Comparing model projections with and without the one-dose schedule yielded an estimated 22.46 additional national HPV vaccine introductions in LMICs. Changepoint analysis identified a significant increase in introductions in 2022. CONCLUSIONS: These results quantify the primary global drivers of HPV vaccine uptake, offering actionable insights for expanding equitable vaccine access.

papers.title: The Vaginal Microbiome Across the Continuum from HPV Infection to Cervical Cancer: A Narrative Review
papers.abstract: Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) infection serves as the core prerequisite for cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN) and invasive cervical cancer. Accumulated translational evidence confirms that vaginal microecological homeostasis dominated by protective Lactobacillus strains fundamentally governs the initiation, persistence, and spontaneous clearance of HR-HPV infection, while microbial dysbiosis featuring depleted lactobacilli and overgrown anaerobic pathogens creates a pro-inflammatory, immune-suppressive mucosal niche that accelerates viral retention and cervical malignant transformation. We conducted a narrative review of studies published primarily between January 2021 and April 2026. PubMed, Web of Science, CNKI, Wanfang Data, and VIP were searched using terms related to the vaginal microbiome, HR-HPV infection, CIN, cervical cancer, underlying mechanisms, microbial biomarkers, and microbiome-modulating interventions. Relevant peer-reviewed epidemiological, mechanistic, and clinical studies were prioritized, and the manuscript was prepared with reference to the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles (SANRA). This review systematically delineates the bidirectional regulatory crosstalk between vaginal microbiota and HR-HPV across the cervical cancer continuum. Dysbiosis disrupts vaginal acidic barriers, reshapes local cytokine networks, impairs antiviral innate immunity, and modulates HPV E6/E7 oncogenic transcription; reciprocally, HR-HPV oncoproteins remodel microbial community structures to sustain a dysbiotic feedback loop. Three core carcinogenic cascades induced by dysbiotic flora are elaborated: epithelial barrier erosion, metabolic reprogramming, and epigenetic rewiring of host and viral genomes. Dynamic microbial characteristics corresponding to all stages of progressive cervical lesions, from transient HPV infection to high-grade CIN and carcinoma, are sorted out. The bench-to-bedside translational progress of microbiome-targeted interventions is summarized, including single/multi-strain probiotic supplementation, engineered lactic acid bacterial therapeutic vaccines, vaginal microbiota transplantation, and traditional Chinese medicine therapy that reconstructs vaginal eubiosis. The clinical application of microbial diversity, strain-level single-nucleotide variants, and taxonomic biomarkers for early screening, efficacy prediction, and postoperative recurrence risk stratification is illustrated. This comprehensive framework with the vaginal microbiome as the core clarifies the internal mechanism of HR-HPV progression along the entire pathway to cervical cancer and provides practical clinical means to block this cascade. Current bottlenecks, including inconsistent probiotic standards, preclinical model limitations, and unresolved gut–vagina microbiome interactions, require further investigation before widespread clinical translation.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 持续的高危型人乳头瘤病毒(HR-HPV)感染是宫颈上皮内瘤变(CIN)和侵袭性宫颈癌的核心前提。本综述探讨了在整个宫颈癌连续谱中阴道微生物群与HR-HPV之间的双向调控相互作用,重点分析了微生物失调、其对病毒感染的影响以及向宫颈癌发展的过程。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 我们对2021年1月至2026年4月期间发表的主要研究进行了叙述性综述。通过PubMed、Web of Science、CNKI、万方数据和VIP数据库,使用与阴道微生物群、HR-HPV感染、CIN、宫颈癌、潜在机制、微生物生物标志物以及微生物群调节干预相关的关键词进行检索。优先选取了相关的同行评审流行病学、机制和临床研究,并参考了叙述性综述文章评估量表(SANRA)撰写本文。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 微生物失调会破坏阴道酸性屏障,重塑局部细胞因子网络,损害抗病毒药物固有免疫,并调节HPV E6/E7致癌转录;反之,HR-HPV致癌蛋白则重塑微生物群落结构,维持一种失调的反馈循环。详细阐述了由失调微生物群引发的三种核心致癌级联反应:上皮屏障侵蚀、代谢重编程以及宿主和病毒基因组的表观遗传重排。梳理了与宫颈病变进展所有阶段相关的动态微生物特征,从短暂的HPV感染到高级别CIN和癌变。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 当前的瓶颈包括益生菌标准不一致、临床前模型的局限性以及未解决的肠道-阴道微生物群相互作用,这些都需要在广泛临床转化之前进一步研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 总结了针对微生物群的干预措施从实验室到临床的转化进展,包括单株/多株益生菌补充、工程化乳酸菌治疗疫苗、阴道微生物群移植以及能够重建阴道生态平衡的传统中医药疗法。展示了微生物多样性、菌株水平单核苷酸变异和分类学生物标志物在早期筛查、疗效预测和术后复发风险分层中的临床应用。

papers.title: Contemporary global prevalence and genotype distribution of human papillomavirus among female sex workers, 2015–2025: an updated systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Female sex workers experience disproportionate exposure to human papillomavirus (HPV), but estimates of HPV prevalence and genotype distribution vary according to geography, specimen type, diagnostic method, and genotype coverage. This updated systematic review and meta-analysis synthesized contemporary evidence published between February 2015 and December 2025. Methods PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science were systematically searched without language restrictions. Two reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and critically appraised included studies using the JBI checklist for prevalence studies. One independent estimate was retained per study population for the primary analysis to avoid double-counting. Overall and type-specific HPV prevalence estimates were synthesized using random-effects generalized linear mixed models with logit transformation. Heterogeneity, prediction intervals, subgroup patterns, and sensitivity analyses were examined. The review was not prospectively registered. Results Thirty-six independent study/population estimates from 23 countries included 12,193 female sex workers, of whom 5,586 were HPV positive. The pooled HPV prevalence was 39.0% (95% confidence interval, 30.0%-48.9%), with very high heterogeneity (I2=97.6%) and a wide prediction interval (5.0%-88.6%). Prevalence varied across World Bank geographic regions, country income groups, diagnostic methods, and specimen types. Among genotypes assessed in at least 10 studies, HPV-52 had the highest pooled prevalence, followed by HPV-53 and HPV-16; HPV-58, HPV-35, and HPV-66 each had a pooled prevalence of 5.8%. Sensitivity analyses did not materially change the overall interpretation. Conclusions The available contemporary evidence indicates a substantial overall burden of HPV among female sex workers, although prevalence varies markedly across populations and settings. The broad genotype distribution includes both vaccine-targeted and non-vaccine types and underscores the relevance of vaccination, cervical cancer screening, and integrated STI/HIV prevention services for this population.

papers.title_zh: 当代全球人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染率及人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)基因型分布情况:针对女性性工作者的更新系统综述和荟萃分析(2015–2025)
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background Female sex workers experience disproportionate exposure to human papillomavirus (HPV), but estimates of HPV prevalence and genotype distribution vary according to geography, specimen type, diagnostic method, and genotype coverage. This updated systematic review and meta-analysis synthesized contemporary evidence published between February 2015 and December 2025. Methods PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and Web of Science were systematically searched without language restrictions. Two reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and critically appraised included studies using the JBI checklist for prevalence studies. One independent estimate was retained per study population for the primary analysis to avoid double-counting. Overall and type-specific HPV prevalence estimates were synthesized using random-effects generalized linear mixed models with logit transformation. Heterogeneity, prediction intervals, subgroup patterns, and sensitivity analyses were examined. The review was not prospectively registered. Results Thirty-six independent study/population estimates from 23 countries included 12,193 female sex workers, of whom 5,586 were HPV positive. The pooled HPV prevalence was 39.0% (95% confidence interval, 30.0%-48.9%), with very high heterogeneity (I2=97.6%) and a wide prediction interval (5.0%-88.6%). Prevalence varied across World Bank geographic regions, country income groups, diagnostic methods, and specimen types. Among genotypes assessed in at least 10 studies, HPV-52 had the highest pooled prevalence, followed by HPV-53 and HPV-16; HPV-58, HPV-35, and HPV-66 each had a pooled prevalence of 5.8%. Sensitivity analyses did not materially change the overall interpretation. Conclusions The available contemporary evidence indicates a substantial overall burden of HPV among female sex workers, although prevalence varies markedly across populations and settings. The broad genotype distribution includes both vaccine-targeted and non-vaccine types and underscores the relevance of vaccination, cervical cancer screening, and integrated STI/HIV prevention services for this population.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 女性性工作者面临不成比例的HPV暴露风险,但HPV感染率和基因型分布的估计因地理区域、样本类型、诊断方法和基因型覆盖范围而异。本更新的系统综述和荟萃分析综合了2015年2月至2025年12月间发表的当代证据。方法 通过PubMed/MEDLINE、Scopus和Web of Science进行系统检索,不限制语言。两名评审员独立筛选记录、提取数据,并使用JBI检查表对纳入研究进行批判性评价。为避免重复计数,每项研究人群保留一个独立的估计值。使用对数转换的随机效应广义线性混合模型综合总体和特定型别的HPV感染率估计值。分析了异质性、预测区间、亚组模式和敏感性分析。本综述未进行前瞻性注册。结果 从23个国家纳入了36个独立的研究/人群估计值,共包含12,193名女性性工作者,其中5,586名检测出HPV阳性。综合感染率为39.0%(95%置信区间,30.0%-48.9%),异质性非常高(I2=97.6%),预测区间较宽(5.0%-88.6%)。HPV感染率在世界银行地理区域、国家收入组别、诊断方法和样本类型之间存在显著差异。在至少有10项研究评估的基因型中,HPV-52的综合感染率最高,其次是HPV-53和HPV-16;HPV-58、HPV-35和HPV-66的综合感染率均为5.8%。敏感性分析未显著改变总体解释。结论 当前可用的证据表明,女性性工作者中HPV的总体负担相当大,尽管感染率在不同人群和环境中存在显著差异。广泛的基因型分布包括针对人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)的基因型和非人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)的基因型,强调了针对该人群的人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)筛查、系统发育分析以及整合的性传播疾病(STI)/艾滋病病毒(HIV)预防服务的重要性。

papers.title: Acceptability and preference of self-collected vaginal samples for human papillomavirus DNA testing compared with physician-collected Pap smear.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Self-collected vaginal sampling for human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA testing provides a promising alternative to physician-collected Pap smears, especially in low-resource settings. However, data on its acceptability and preferences among Filipino women remain limited. This study aimed to assess women's perceptions, experiences, willingness and preferences regarding self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing compared with Pap smears. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted among 592 women. Participants underwent both physician-collected Pap smears and self-collected vaginal sampling for HPV DNA testing. Perceptions were measured using five-point Likert scale questionnaires before and after self-collection. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 自我采集阴道样本用于人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)DNA检测为医生采集的巴氏涂片提供了一种有前景的替代方案,特别是在资源匮乏的环境中。然而,关于菲律宾女性对其可接受性和偏好的数据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在592名女性中进行了一项横断面研究。参与者接受了医生采集的巴氏涂片和自我采集的阴道样本用于HPV DNA检测。
elements_zh.methods: 使用五点李克特量表问卷在自我采集前后测量感知。采用描述性统计分析,并使用配对和独立Wilcoxon检验比较李克特量表回答。使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验分析接受筛查的意愿。参与者偏好的筛查方法的原因被主题分类,并以堆叠条形图显示。
elements_zh.main_results: 自我采集通常被认为无痛、不不适、不尴尬且容易和方便。参与者进行自我采集后,可接受性显著提高(疼痛和不适的P < 0.001)。与巴氏涂片相比,自我采集被认为更不尴尬(P < 0.001),但被认为更不便于操作(P = 0.01)和更不方便(P = 0.004)。大多数参与者由于对医疗专业知识的信任以及对程序准确性、安全性和清洁度的信心,更倾向于医生进行的筛查(84.8%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 自我采集阴道样本具有高度可接受性,但医生采集的筛查仍然是首选方法。通过改善自我采集的教育、演示和支持,可能提高HPV DNA检测的参与率,并扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为提高HPV DNA检测参与率和扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性提供策略依据,强调了对自我采集方法进行教育和支持的必要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计和自我报告数据,这可能引入偏倚。证据强度中等,因为它提供了关于可接受性和偏好的见解,但并未建立因果关系。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:自我采集阴道样本用于人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)DNA检测为医生采集的巴氏涂片提供了一种有前景的替代方案,特别是在资源匮乏的环境中。然而,关于菲律宾女性对其可接受性和偏好的数据仍然有限。本研究旨在评估女性对自我采集阴道样本进行HPV DNA检测与巴氏涂片的感知、体验、意愿和偏好。方法:在592名女性中进行了一项横断面研究。参与者接受了医生采集的巴氏涂片和自我采集的阴道样本用于HPV DNA检测。使用五点李克特量表问卷在自我采集前后测量感知。采用描述性统计分析,并使用配对和独立Wilcoxon检验比较李克特量表回答。使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验分析接受筛查的意愿。参与者偏好的筛查方法的原因被主题分类,并以堆叠条形图显示。结果:自我采集通常被认为无痛、不不适、不尴尬且容易和方便。参与者进行自我采集后,可接受性显著提高(疼痛和不适的P < 0.001)。与巴氏涂片相比,自我采集被认为更不尴尬(P < 0.001),但被认为更不便于操作(P = 0.01)和更不方便(P = 0.004)。大多数参与者由于对医疗专业知识的信任以及对程序准确性、安全性和清洁度的信心,更倾向于医生进行的筛查(84.8%)。结论:自我采集阴道样本具有高度可接受性,但医生采集的筛查仍然是首选方法。通过改善自我采集的教育、演示和支持,可能提高HPV DNA检测的参与率,并扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性。科学与公共卫生意义:这些发现可以为提高HPV DNA检测参与率和扩大菲律宾宫颈癌筛查的可及性提供策略依据,强调了对自我采集方法进行教育和支持的必要性。局限性与证据强度:本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计和自我报告数据,这可能引入偏倚。证据强度中等,因为它提供了关于可接受性和偏好的见解,但并未建立因果关系。

papers.title: Caregiver knowledge and Attitudes toward Human Papillomavirus Vaccination among adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone: A health facility-based cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Objective: To assess the knowledge, willingness and barriers to human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination among caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone. Methods This cross-sectional study examined HPV vaccine knowledge, willingness, and barriers among 249 caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone. Data were collected through structured questionnaires at public tertiary hospitals and high-volume HIV clinics, and associations were assessed using chi-square tests, logistic regression, and Kruskal-Wallis analyses. Results Only 32.1% (80/249) of caregivers had heard of HPV, with even fewer aware of its link to cervical cancer (24.4%, 60/246) or prevention methods of cervical cancer (31.9%, 79/248). Misconceptions were prevalent; 16.3% (36/221) erroneously linked oral contraceptives to cervical cancer, and 61.1% (44/72) of caregivers unwilling to vaccinate cited distrust in vaccine efficacy. While tertiary-educated caregivers exhibited the highest level of knowledge (45.5%, p < 0.001), their willingness to vaccinate (50%, 33/66) was comparable to that of less-educated groups, highlighting a knowledge-action gap. Structural barriers dominated, with 66.1% (154/233) citing unawareness of the vaccine and 10.3% (24/233) missing school-based vaccination days. Relationship dynamics significantly influenced willingness: extended family members showed the highest willingness (69.4%, p = 0.029), whereas grandparents were least willing (31%, 9/29). Although systemic gaps such disrupted vaccination services, vaccines supplies and cold chain limited uptake, healthcare workers emerged as the most effective information source (rank sum = 889.5, p = 0.039). Conclusion The study highlights needs for culturally tailored education to dispel myths, community-driven strategies engaging trusted actors like healthcare workers and extended families.This study justifies the need for integration of HPV vaccination and cervical cancer screening into HIV care services.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate caregiver knowledge, willingness, and barriers to human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination among adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone, addressing the gap in understanding how these factors influence vaccination decisions in this specific population.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A health facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 249 caregivers of adolescent girls living with HIV in Sierra Leone, focusing on their awareness and attitudes toward HPV vaccination.
analysis.methods: Structured questionnaires were used to collect data at public tertiary hospitals and high-volume HIV clinics, with statistical analyses including chi-square tests, logistic regression, and Kruskal-Wallis tests to assess associations.
analysis.main_results: Only 32.1% (80/249) of caregivers had heard of HPV, and fewer were aware of its link to cervical cancer (24.4%, 60/246) or prevention methods (31.9%, 79/248). Misconceptions were common, with 16.3% (36/221) linking oral contraceptives to cervical cancer, and 61.1% (44/72) of caregivers unwilling to vaccinate citing distrust in vaccine efficacy.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study reveals a significant knowledge-action gap, as tertiary-educated caregivers had the highest knowledge but similar willingness to vaccinate as less-educated groups, indicating that knowledge alone does not translate to action.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for culturally tailored education to address misconceptions and improve vaccination uptake, as well as the integration of HPV vaccination and cervical cancer screening into HIV care services.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Structural barriers, such as unawareness of the vaccine and missed vaccination days, were prominent, and the evidence is moderate due to the cross-sectional design and potential for self-reporting bias.

Misconceptions, such as linking oral contraceptives to cervical cancer, were prevalent, and distrust in vaccine efficacy was a major barrier. Tertiary-educated caregivers had the highest knowledge but similar willingness to vaccinate as less-educated groups, highlighting a knowledge-action gap. Structural barriers, including unawareness of the vaccine and missed vaccination days, were significant. papers.abstract_zh: 目的:评估塞拉利昂接受HIV治疗的青少年女孩照顾者对人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)的认知、意愿及其障碍。方法:本横断面研究在塞拉利昂的公立三级医院和高流量HIV诊所中,通过结构化问卷调查了249名照顾者对HPV的认知、意愿及其障碍。数据通过卡方检验、逻辑回归分析和Kruskal-Wallis检验进行统计分析,以评估相关性。结果:仅有32.1%(80/249)的照顾者听说过HPV,更少的人了解其与宫颈癌(24.4%,60/246)或预防方法(31.9%,79/248)之间的关联。存在普遍的误解,其中16.3%(36/221)的照顾者错误地将口服避孕药与宫颈癌联系起来,而61.1%(44/72)不愿接种疫苗的照顾者则表示对疫苗有效性的不信任。尽管受过高等教育的照顾者表现出最高的知识水平(45.5%,p < 0.001),但他们的疫苗接种意愿(50%,33/66)与受教育程度较低的群体相似,凸显了知识与行动之间的差距。结构性障碍占主导地位,其中66.1%(154/233)的照顾者表示不了解疫苗,10.3%(24/233)错过了学校安排的疫苗接种日。关系动态显著影响了疫苗接种意愿:扩展家庭成员表现出最高的意愿(69.4%,p = 0.029),而祖父母则意愿最低(31%,9/29)。尽管系统性障碍如疫苗接种服务中断、疫苗供应和冷链限制了疫苗接种率,但医疗工作者作为信息来源被证明是最有效的(秩和 = 889.5,p = 0.039)。结论:本研究强调了需要进行文化定制的教育以消除误解,并采用社区驱动的策略,通过医疗工作者和扩展家庭等值得信赖的行动者来提高疫苗接种率。本研究支持将HPV疫苗接种和宫颈癌筛查整合到HIV治疗服务中的必要性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估塞拉利昂接受HIV治疗的青少年女孩照顾者对人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)疫苗接种的认知、意愿及其障碍,以填补对这些因素如何影响该特定人群疫苗接种决策的理解空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究在塞拉利昂的249名接受HIV治疗的青少年女孩照顾者中进行,是一项基于医疗机构的横断面研究,重点考察他们对HPV疫苗接种的认知和态度。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过结构化问卷在公立三级医院和高流量HIV诊所中收集数据,统计分析包括卡方检验、逻辑回归分析和Kruskal-Wallis检验,以评估相关性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 仅有32.1%(80/249)的照顾者听说过HPV,更少的人了解其与宫颈癌(24.4%,60/246)或预防方法(31.9%,79/248)之间的关联。存在普遍的误解,其中16.3%(36/221)的照顾者错误地将口服避孕药与宫颈癌联系起来,而61.1%(44/72)不愿接种疫苗的照顾者则表示对疫苗有效性的不信任。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究揭示了显著的知识与行动之间的差距,尽管受过高等教育的照顾者具有最高的知识水平(45.5%,p < 0.001),但他们的疫苗接种意愿(50%,33/66)与受教育程度较低的群体相似,表明知识本身并不足以转化为行动。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了需要进行文化定制的教育以消除误解并提高疫苗接种率,同时也支持将HPV疫苗接种和宫颈癌筛查整合到HIV治疗服务中的必要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 结构性障碍,如对疫苗的不了解和错过学校安排的疫苗接种日,较为突出,且由于研究采用横断面设计,可能存在自我报告偏差,因此证据强度中等。

papers.title: HPV-Associated Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Persistent Oral High-Risk HPV Detection: A Narrative Review of Longitudinal Assessment, Diagnostic Evaluation, and Surveillance
papers.abstract: Currently, no validated population-based screening strategy uses persistent oral high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) detection to identify individuals at clinically meaningful risk of HPV-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC). This narrative review evaluates sampling strategies, virologic assays, liquid-biopsy biomarkers, adjunct biomarkers, and integrative approaches across three clinical contexts: longitudinal oral HPV assessment; diagnostic evaluation and HPV attribution in suspected or newly diagnosed OPSCC; and treatment monitoring and post-treatment surveillance in established HPV-associated OPSCC. The literature published from January 2020 through June 2026 and identified in PubMed was synthesized by clinical context, specimen source, biological target, study population, and intended use. Repeated detection of the same high-risk HPV genotype in serial oral specimens provides a pragmatic measure of persistent oral HPV detection but does not establish uninterrupted infection, sustained viral oncogene transcription, malignant transformation, or future OPSCC risk. Oral HPV DNA, oral E6/E7 mRNA, tumor-tissue HPV testing, and plasma circulating tumor HPV DNA represent distinct biological and clinical signals. Plasma circulating tumor HPV DNA has the most mature evidence for treatment monitoring and post-treatment surveillance in established HPV-associated OPSCC, not population screening. Clinical translation requires standardized longitudinal protocols, validation in intended-use populations, actionable management pathways, and incremental predictive value for proposed risk-stratification models.

analysis.summary_en: This narrative review focuses on the role of persistent oral high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) detection in identifying individuals at risk for HPV-associated oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC). The review synthesizes evidence from studies published between January 2020 and June 2026, sourced from PubMed, and categorizes findings by clinical context, specimen source, and intended use. Finally, it emphasizes the need for standardized protocols, validation in target populations, and actionable pathways for clinical translation.

papers.title: Phosphorylated HPV‐16 E7 disrupts planar cell polarity in cervical cancer cells through vangl1 dysregulation.
papers.abstract: High‐risk (HR) human papillomaviruses (HPVs) rely on the continuous expression of the E6 and E7 oncoproteins to reshape epithelial biology, drive and sustain malignant transformation. The high‐risk E7 oncoprotein is multifunctional, and its phosphorylation by Casein Kinase II (CKII) is a key post translational modification that amplifies its oncogenic potential. Therefore, it is important to extensively delineate the consequences of E7 phosphorylation on HPV-driven transformation and malignant progression. Here, we identify Vangl1, a core planar cell polarity (PCP) scaffold protein, as a novel, phosphorylation‐dependent interactor of HPV‐16 E7. Through proteomics, biochemical and cell-based assays, this study established that CKII‐mediated phosphorylation is required for Vangl1 recruitment, and that this interaction is more pronounced with HPV‐16 E7, revealing a new mechanism by which HR HPVs might disrupt epithelial organization. In CaSki cells and ectopic expression models, E7 expression profoundly disrupts Vangl1 homeostasis, creating a biphasic proteostatic imbalance in which phosphorylated Vangl1 is aberrantly stabilised. This retention parallels E7 stability, revealing a reciprocal oncogenic stabilization. Furthermore, we found that Vangl1 is depleted in cytoskeletal cell fractions in the presence of E7, and that E7 translocates to membrane compartments where it colocalizes with Vangl1. In line with this, we identified that this abnormal Vangl1 stabilization occurs from its mislocalization and impaired trafficking arising from E7's interference with the Adaptor-Related Protein Complex 1 Subunit Mu 1 (AP1M1). Functionally, Vangl1 siRNA-mediated ablation in CaSki spheroids mirrors E6/E7 loss, leading to disrupted spheroidal architecture, reduced invasion, and increased sensitivity to chemotherapeutic stress. These phenotypes position Vangl1 as a key downstream effector through which E7 reshaped epithelial behaviour. Taken together, our findings reveal a CKII-dependent mechanism by which HPV-16 E7 hijacks a core planar polarity component to destabilize epithelial structure and promote malignant traits; thus, positioning Vangl1 as a potential druggable target in HPV-associated cervical cancer.

analysis.methods: Proteomics, biochemical, and cell-based assays were used to establish the interaction between CKII-phosphorylated HPV-16 E7 and Vangl1, and to assess the effects of E7 on Vangl1 homeostasis and epithelial structure.

papers.abstract_zh: 高危型(HR)人乳头瘤病毒(HPVs)依赖于E6和E7癌蛋白的持续表达来重塑上皮生物学,驱动并维持恶性转化。高危型E7癌蛋白具有多种功能,其由酪蛋白激酶II(CKII)介导的磷酸化是关键的翻译后修饰,增强了其致癌潜能。因此,有必要全面阐明E7磷酸化对HPV驱动的转化和恶性进展的影响。本研究发现,Vangl1是一种核心的平面细胞极性(PCP)支架蛋白,是HPV-16 E7的一种新型、依赖磷酸化的相互作用蛋白。通过蛋白质组学、生化和细胞实验,本研究证实CKII介导的磷酸化对于Vangl1的招募是必需的,并且这种相互作用在HPV-16 E7中更为显著,揭示了高危型HPVs可能通过干扰上皮组织结构的新机制。在CaSki细胞和异位表达模型中,E7的表达显著破坏了Vangl1的稳态,导致双相的蛋白质稳态失衡,其中磷酸化的Vangl1异常稳定。这种保留与E7的稳定性相呼应,揭示了一种相互依赖的致癌性稳定机制。此外,我们发现,在E7存在的情况下,Vangl1在细胞骨架部分被耗尽,并且E7会转移到膜区室,与Vangl1共定位。与此一致,我们发现这种异常的Vangl1稳定化源于E7对适配蛋白相关蛋白复合体1亚基Mu 1(AP1M1)的干扰所导致的Vangl1定位异常和运输受损。功能上,Vangl1 siRNA介导的敲除在CaSki球体中模拟了E6/E7的缺失,导致球体结构破坏、侵袭性降低以及对化疗压力的敏感性增加。这些表型表明Vangl1是E7重塑上皮行为的关键下游效应因子。综上所述,我们的研究揭示了HPV-16 E7通过CKII依赖机制劫持核心平面极性成分,从而破坏上皮结构并促进恶性特征;因此,将Vangl1定位为HPV相关宫颈癌的潜在可药靶点。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解磷酸化的人乳头瘤病毒HPV-16 E7如何通过Vangl1调控失调破坏平面细胞极性(PCP),以阐明E7磷酸化对HPV驱动的转化和恶性进展的影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用CaSki细胞和异位表达模型来研究HPV-16 E7与Vangl1的相互作用,重点关注CKII介导的磷酸化对Vangl1稳态和上皮组织结构的影响。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用蛋白质组学、生化和细胞实验来建立CKII磷酸化的人乳头瘤病毒HPV-16 E7与Vangl1的相互作用,并评估E7对Vangl1稳态和上皮结构的影响。
analysis_zh.main_results: 本研究发现,CKII介导的HPV-16 E7磷酸化对于Vangl1的招募是必需的,导致双相的蛋白质稳态失衡,其中磷酸化的Vangl1异常稳定。E7的表达破坏了Vangl1的稳态,而Vangl1 siRNA介导的敲除在CaSki球体中模拟了E6/E7的缺失,导致球体结构破坏、侵袭性降低以及对化疗压力的敏感性增加。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究识别了Vangl1作为HPV-16 E7的一种新型、依赖磷酸化的相互作用蛋白,揭示了高危型HPVs可能通过干扰上皮组织结构的新机制。这一发现将Vangl1定位为HPV相关宫颈癌的潜在可药靶点。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,针对Vangl1可能是一种治疗HPV相关宫颈癌的策略,因为E7介导的Vangl1稳定化破坏了上皮结构并促进了恶性特征。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用单一细胞系和异位表达模型,这些可能无法完全代表体内条件的复杂性。由于依赖于体外模型,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Real-world safety data of human papillomavirus vaccines after marketing in Shandong, China, August 2017–October 2025
papers.abstract: After the Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine was listed for use in China in 2017, it has proven to be a safe and cost-effective method for preventing HPV infection. With the increase in vaccination volume, its safety is becoming increasingly important. The safety data from post-marketing can enhance public confidence in vaccines. We collected adverse events following immunization (AEFI) through the Chinese National AEFI Information Management System (CNAEFIs) between August 2017 and October 2025. Vaccination data from the same period were obtained via the Shandong Provincial Immunization Program Information Systems (SDIPIs). A Univariate Poisson regression model was used to explore risk factors associated with HPV vaccine AEFI. Disproportionality analysis was performed to detect abnormal signals related to the HPV vaccine. From August 2017 to October 2025 in Shandong, CNAEFIs received 1056 AEFI cases, with an overall reporting AEFI rate of 7.99 per 100,000 doses. 1008 cases (95.46%) were mild vaccine-related reactions, and 15 cases (1.42%) were rare adverse reactions. Myalgia, induration with a diameter greater than 5 cm, immune thrombocytopenia, and mild reactions such as fatigue, drowsiness, dizziness, and headache were detected as abnormal signals. The reporting AEFI rate of the HPV vaccine in Shandong was low, and the majority of AEFIs were mild cases. The safety profile in post-marketing was good.

The reporting AEFI rate of the HPV vaccine in Shandong was low, and the majority of AEFIs were mild cases. The safety profile in post-marketing was good.

papers.title: Knowledge of Human Papillomavirus and Willingness to Recommend HPV Vaccination for Young Girls Among Doctors in Peshawar: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary cause of cervical cancer, which remains an important public health problem in low- and middle-income countries. HPV vaccination is an effective strategy for preventing HPV-related disease, but vaccine uptake in Pakistan remains limited. Healthcare providers can play an important role in communicating the benefits of HPV vaccination and recommending vaccination to eligible adolescents. As Khyber Pakhtunkhwa prepares for HPV vaccine implementation, assessing physicians' knowledge and willingness to recommend vaccination is important. This study aimed to assess HPV-related knowledge and willingness to recommend HPV vaccination among doctors in Peshawar, Pakistan. Methods: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from August 2025 to January 2026 among 189 registered doctors in public sector hospitals in Peshawar. Participants completed a structured, self-administered questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of HPV infection and vaccination, and willingness to recommend the vaccine. Knowledge scores were categorised as good, moderate, or poor. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, tests of association, and multivariable binary logistic regression. Adjusted odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were reported. Results: The mean knowledge score was 12.71 ± 3.01, and 121 participants (64.0%) had good knowledge. Overall, 144 participants (76.2%) reported willingness to recommend HPV vaccination. Doctors who had received formal HPV training had higher mean knowledge scores than those without prior training (13.97 ± 1.84 vs. 12.38 ± 3.17; p Conclusion: Most doctors in Peshawar demonstrated good HPV-related knowledge and reported a high willingness to recommend HPV vaccination. Higher HPV knowledge was associated with greater adjusted odds of willingness to recommend vaccination, although the overall multivariable model had limited explanatory power. Strengthening HPV-related education, together with clear clinical and implementation guidance, may support physicians in communicating HPV vaccination to eligible adolescents as vaccination programmes expand in Pakistan.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human papillomavirus (HPV) infection is the primary cause of cervical cancer, which remains an important public health problem in low- and middle-income countries. HPV vaccination is an effective strategy for preventing HPV-related disease, but vaccine uptake in Pakistan remains limited.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted from August 2025 to January 2026 among 189 registered doctors in public sector hospitals in Peshawar. Participants completed a structured, self-administered questionnaire assessing sociodemographic characteristics, knowledge of HPV infection and vaccination, and willingness to recommend the vaccine.
analysis.methods: Knowledge scores were categorised as good, moderate, or poor. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics, tests of association, and multivariable binary logistic regression.
analysis.main_results: The mean knowledge score was 12.71 ± 3.01, and 121 participants (64.0%) had good knowledge. Overall, 144 participants (76.2%) reported willingness to recommend HPV vaccination. Doctors who had received formal HPV training had higher mean knowledge scores than those without prior training (13.97 ± 1.84 vs. 12.38 ± 3.17; p < 0.001). Adjusted odds ratios (ORs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were reported.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Higher HPV knowledge was associated with greater adjusted odds of willingness to recommend vaccination, although the overall multivariable model had limited explanatory power. Most doctors in Peshawar demonstrated good HPV-related knowledge and reported a high willingness to recommend HPV vaccination.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Strengthening HPV-related education, together with clear clinical and implementation guidance, may support physicians in communicating HPV vaccination to eligible adolescents as vaccination programmes expand in Pakistan.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The overall multivariable model had limited explanatory power, and the study was conducted in a single city, which may limit generalisability.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed HPV-related knowledge and willingness to recommend vaccination among doctors in Peshawar, Pakistan. The study found that most doctors had good knowledge of HPV and were willing to recommend vaccination, with higher knowledge associated with greater willingness. However, the multivariable model had limited explanatory power, and the study's findings may not be generalizable beyond Peshawar. The results suggest the importance of strengthening HPV education and providing clear guidance to support physicians in promoting vaccination as programs expand in Pakistan.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染是导致宫颈癌的主要原因,这在低收入和中等收入国家仍然是重要的公共卫生问题。HPV 疫苗接种是预防HPV相关疾病的有效策略,但在巴基斯坦,疫苗的接种率仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究是一项基于医院的横断面研究,于2025年8月至2026年1月期间在白沙瓦的公立医疗机构中对189名注册医生进行。参与者完成了评估社会人口学特征、HPV感染及疫苗接种知识,以及推荐疫苗意愿的结构化、自我管理问卷。
elements_zh.methods: 知识得分被分为良好、中等和较差三类。数据通过描述性统计、关联性检验和多变量二元逻辑回归进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 平均知识得分为12.71 ± 3.01,其中121名参与者(64.0%)具有良好的知识。总体而言,144名参与者(76.2%)表示愿意推荐HPV 疫苗接种。接受过正式HPV培训的医生平均知识得分高于未接受过培训的医生(13.97 ± 1.84 vs. 12.38 ± 3.17;p < 0.001)。报告了调整后的比值比(ORs)及其95%置信区间(CIs)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 尽管整体多变量模型的解释力有限,但HPV知识水平较高与推荐疫苗接种的调整后比值比更高相关。白沙瓦的大多数医生展示了良好的HPV相关知识,并表示有较高的意愿推荐HPV 疫苗接种。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 加强HPV相关教育,结合明确的临床和实施指导,可能有助于医生在巴基斯坦扩大疫苗接种项目时向适龄青少年传播该疫苗的信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 整体多变量模型的解释力有限,且本研究仅在单一城市进行,这可能限制其推广性。

papers.title: Factors influencing human papillomavirus school-based immunization in Alberta: a qualitative inquiry
papers.abstract: Abstract Objectives While human papillomavirus (HPV) infections and associated cancers are preventable through immunization, vaccine coverage for school-aged boys and girls remains suboptimal in Alberta and across Canada. To reconcile this coverage gap and inform Alberta’s school-based HPV immunization program, this study looks to understand barriers and enablers of immunization, how they vary across health zones and population groups, and summarize recommendations to overcome these barriers. Methods Virtual interviews were conducted with members of the Healthier Together Panel of Albertans who were parents/guardians of school-aged children (11–17 years old). Program stakeholders (e.g., leaders, front-line workers) were separately invited to participate in virtual focus groups. Development of study materials and data analysis were guided by the Conceptual Framework of Access to Health Care. Template thematic analysis was used to analyze the interview and focus group data. Results Enablers of HPV immunization included convenience of the school-based program, normalization of the vaccine alongside other routine vaccines, relationship building with schools, parents/guardians, and communities, messaging that included personal stories, and youth engagement. Barriers included gaps in HPV knowledge, perceived lack of trust and transparency, links to sexual activity, consent processes, language barriers, and immunization anxiety. However, the qualitative nature of the data and potential biases limit the strength of the evidence, which is assessed as moderate.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 尽管人乳头瘤病毒(人乳头瘤病毒)感染及其相关癌症可通过疫苗接种预防,但阿尔伯塔省及加拿大其他地区针对学龄男孩和女孩的疫苗接种率仍不理想。为弥合这一接种差距并为阿尔伯塔省的学校为基础的HPV疫苗接种计划提供信息,本研究旨在了解疫苗接种的障碍和促进因素,这些因素在不同健康区和人口群体中的差异,以及总结克服这些障碍的建议。方法 与阿尔伯塔省健康者共同参与的Healthier Together小组成员进行了虚拟访谈,这些成员是学龄儿童(11-17岁)的父母或监护人。另外,还邀请了计划相关利益相关者(如领导者和一线工作人员)参加虚拟焦点小组。研究材料的开发和数据分析由健康护理可及性概念框架指导。使用模板主题分析法对访谈和焦点小组数据进行分析。结果 HPV疫苗接种的促进因素包括学校为基础的计划的便利性、将疫苗与其他常规疫苗一同推广、与学校、父母/监护人和社区建立关系、包含个人故事的信息传播以及青少年参与。障碍包括对HPV知识的缺乏、对信任和透明度的感知缺失、与性活动的关联、接种同意流程、语言障碍以及接种焦虑。关键建议包括改善HPV信息传播以解决知识差距和误解、改变计划材料的分发方式、采用减少接种焦虑的策略,以及继续与父母/监护人、学校和社区建立关系。结论 识别出需要改善HPV信息传播以解决知识差距和误解。未来的工作可以考虑其他提供者的视角,包括家庭医生和药剂师。

papers.title: HUMAN PAPILLOMAVIRUS GENOTYPE DISTRIBUTION AMONG ADULT WOMEN IN THE RABAT REGION (MOROCCO): A RETROSPECTIVE AND ANALYTICAL STUDY WITH IMPLICATIONS FOR HPV VACCINATION STRATEGIES.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Cervical cancer (CC) remains a major public health challenge in Morocco, where it is the second most frequent cancer among women. Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) is the primary etiological factor. Limited data exist regarding HPV genotype distribution and associated risk factors in the Moroccan female population. METHODS: A retrospective, descriptive, and analytical study was conducted at the Mohammed V Military Teaching Hospital, Rabat, Morocco, between May 2023 and April 2025. Asymptomatic women aged 30-65 years undergoing routine CC screening were included. Cervical samples were collected using liquid-based cytology medium and analyzed for HR-HPV using the Cobas® 4800 assay. Samples positive for pooled HR-HPV (excluding HPV16/18) underwent extended genotyping using the HPV002® assay. Sociodemographic, behavioral, and clinical data were collected via standardized questionnaires. Statistical analysis included prevalence estimates, univariate, and multivariate logistic regression to identify factors independently associated with HR-HPV infection. RESULTS: Of 2.235 eligible women, HR-HPV prevalence was 5.5% (n=123). HPV16 was the most prevalent genotype (19.5%), followed by HPV68 (12.2%), HPV31 (9.8%), HPV33 (7.3%), HPV35 (7.3%), and HPV39 (7.3%). Single-genotype infections predominated (95%), with dual infections in 5% of cases. Genotypes targeted by the 9-valent HPV vaccine accounted for 58.5% of infections. Multivariate analysis identified diabetes/immunosuppression, hormonal contraceptive use, and inflammatory cervical abnormalities as independent predictors of HR-HPV infection. 75% of HR-HPV-positive women were over 40 years, with a peak prevalence in the 50-59 age group. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first detailed characterization of HR-HPV prevalence and genotype distribution in Moroccan women attending a tertiary hospital. HPV16 remains the predominant genotype. A significant proportion of infections are preventable by the 9-valent vaccine. These findings highlight the urgent need for expanded HPV vaccination and molecular-based screening programs in Morocco and provide a critical baseline for monitoring vaccine impact and guiding public health strategies.

papers.title: Beyond cervicovaginal limitations: potential bidirectional interactions between HPV infection and mucosal microbiota from oral, anorectal and penile sites — a mini-review
papers.abstract: Most existing studies focusing on human papillomavirus (HPV)-microbiota interactions are confined to the cervicovaginal tract, while mucosal microecological crosstalk at oral, anorectal and penile sites remains insufficiently summarized. This mini-review provides a narrative synthesis of current sequencing and epidemiological evidence regarding potential bidirectional interactions between HPV infection and site-specific mucosal microbiota across extra-cervicovaginal niches in both males and females. Oral HPV reshapes microbial composition in a sex-, race- and population-dependent manner; periodontal dysbiosis, high-risk HPV and Candida albicans jointly form a tripartite oncogenic axis that may contribute to oral squamous cell carcinoma, and periodontal inflammation independently elevates oral HPV susceptibility. Among men who have sex with men, pro-inflammatory anaerobes such as Bacteroides fragilis and Sneathia accumulate in anorectal HPV-related lesions, and concurrent HIV or sexually transmitted bacterial co-infections worsen mucosal dysbiosis and viral persistence. On penile skin, Corynebacterium is associated with a lower prevalence of HPV, whereas anaerobe-dominant community state types increase high-risk HPV risk, with HIV-induced baseline dysbiosis masking HPV-specific penile microbial signatures. Collectively, tissue-specific mucosal dysbiosis may represent an important co-factor linked to persistent HPV infection and subsequent malignant transformation. This review offsets long-standing sex-related and anatomical research bias, clarifies multi-site host-virus-microbe mechanisms, and provides theoretical support for developing microbiota-based biomarkers and microecological interventions to prevent non-cervical HPV-associated malignancies.
papers.journal: Frontiers in Cellular and Infection Microbiology

Oral HPV reshapes microbial composition in a sex-, race- and population-dependent manner; periodontal dysbiosis, high-risk HPV and Candida albicans jointly form a tripartite oncogenic axis that may contribute to oral squamous cell carcinoma, and periodontal inflammation independently elevates oral HPV susceptibility. Among men who have sex with men, pro-inflammatory anaerobes such as Bacteroides fragilis and Sneathia accumulate in anorectal HPV-related lesions, and concurrent HIV or sexually transmitted bacterial co-infections worsen mucosal dysbiosis and viral persistence. On penile skin, Corynebacterium is associated with a lower prevalence of HPV, whereas anaerobe-dominant community state types increase high-risk HPV risk, with HIV-induced baseline dysbiosis masking HPV-specific penile microbial signatures. Collectively, tissue-specific mucosal dysbiosis may represent an important co-factor linked to persistent HPV infection and subsequent malignant transformation. This review offsets long-standing sex-related and anatomical research bias, clarifies multi-site host-virus-microbe mechanisms, and provides theoretical support for developing microbiota-based biomarkers and microecological interventions to prevent non-cervical HPV-associated malignancies.

papers.title_original: Beyond cervicovaginal limitations: potential bidirectional interactions between HPV infection and mucosal microbiota from oral, anorectal and penile sites — a mini-review

analysis.scope_and_question: The review explores the bidirectional interactions between human papillomavirus (HPV) infection and mucosal microbiota at oral, anorectal, and penile sites, with a focus on how these interactions may influence HPV persistence and malignant transformation. The central question is whether microbiota alterations contribute to HPV-related diseases beyond the cervicovaginal tract.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of sequencing and epidemiological evidence from studies on HPV and mucosal microbiota interactions. It does not report specific databases, search dates, or meta-analysis methods, but it summarizes findings from multiple sources on the topic.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: There is consensus that oral HPV infection alters microbial composition in a sex-, race-, and population-dependent manner. A tripartite oncogenic axis involving periodontal dysbiosis, high-risk HPV, and Candida albicans is implicated in oral squamous cell carcinoma. Additionally, periodontal inflammation independently increases susceptibility to oral HPV. In men who have sex with men, anorectal HPV-related lesions are associated with pro-inflammatory anaerobes like Bacteroides fragilis and Sneathia, and HIV or bacterial co-infections exacerbate mucosal dysbiosis. On penile skin, anaerobe-dominant community state types are linked to increased high-risk HPV risk, while HIV-induced dysbiosis may obscure HPV-specific microbial signatures.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The evidence is limited in its ability to fully characterize the microbiota signatures specific to HPV infection at penile sites due to the masking effect of HIV-induced dysbiosis. There is also a lack of comprehensive data on the role of microbiota in HPV-associated malignancies at non-cervicovaginal sites, particularly in diverse populations.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should focus on elucidating the microbiota signatures specific to HPV infection in penile sites, accounting for HIV-induced dysbiosis. Additionally, there is a need for more studies on the role of microbiota in HPV-associated malignancies at non-cervicovaginal sites, with an emphasis on diverse populations. These findings could support the development of microbiota-based biomarkers and interventions for preventing non-cervical HPV-related cancers.

In men who have sex with men, anorectal HPV-related lesions are associated with pro-inflammatory anaerobes, and HIV or bacterial co-infections worsen dysbiosis. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述探讨了人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染与口腔、肛门和阴茎部位黏膜微生物群之间的双向相互作用,重点分析这些相互作用如何影响HPV的持续感染和恶性转化。核心问题是:微生物群的变化是否在宫颈阴道以外的部位也与HPV相关疾病的发生有关?
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述是关于HPV与黏膜微生物群相互作用的测序和流行病学证据的叙述性综合。它未报告特定数据库、搜索日期或元分析方法,而是总结了多个来源关于该主题的研究发现。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 有共识认为,口腔HPV感染会以性别、种族和人群依赖的方式改变微生物组成。牙周失调、高危型HPV和白色念珠菌共同形成的三元致癌轴可能与口腔鳞状细胞癌相关。此外,牙周炎症独立增加了口腔HPV的易感性。在男同性恋者中,与肛门HPV相关的病变与促炎厌氧菌如脆弱拟杆菌和斯奈特氏菌有关,而HIV或细菌共感染会加剧黏膜失调。在阴茎皮肤上,以厌氧菌为主的社区状态类型与较高的高危型HPV风险相关,而HIV引起的失调可能掩盖了与HPV特异性相关的微生物特征。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 由于HIV引起的失调可能掩盖了阴茎部位HPV感染特有的微生物特征,目前的证据在充分描述这些部位HPV感染的微生物特征方面存在局限。此外,关于非宫颈部位HPV相关恶性肿瘤中微生物群作用的全面数据仍缺乏,特别是在多样化人群中。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应着重于阐明阴茎部位HPV感染特有的微生物特征,并考虑HIV引起的失调影响。此外,还需要更多关于非宫颈部位HPV相关恶性肿瘤中微生物群作用的研究,特别是针对多样化人群。这些发现可能支持开发基于微生物群的生物标志物和干预措施,以预防非宫颈HPV相关癌症。

papers.abstract_zh: 目前大多数关于HPV-微生物群相互作用的研究局限于宫颈阴道部位,而口腔、肛门和阴茎部位黏膜微生物群的相互作用仍缺乏充分总结。本简要综述通过叙述性综合,总结了现有关于HPV感染与口腔、肛门和阴茎部位特定黏膜微生物群之间潜在双向相互作用的测序和流行病学证据。口腔HPV感染会以性别、种族和人群依赖的方式改变微生物组成;牙周失调、高危型HPV和白色念珠菌共同形成一个三元致癌轴,可能与口腔鳞状细胞癌相关,且牙周炎症独立增加了口腔HPV的易感性。在男同性恋者中,与肛门HPV相关的病变中积累了如脆弱拟杆菌和斯奈特氏菌等促炎厌氧菌,同时并发HIV或性传播细菌感染会加剧黏膜失调和病毒持续感染。在阴茎皮肤上,棒状杆菌与较低的高危型HPV风险相关,而以厌氧菌为主的社区状态类型则与较高的高危型HPV风险相关,HIV引起的基线失调可能掩盖了与HPV特异性相关的阴茎微生物特征。总体而言,特定部位的黏膜失调可能代表与持续HPV感染及随后恶性转化相关的重要共因子。本综述弥补了长期存在的性别相关和解剖学研究偏见,阐明了多部位HPV-病毒-微生物机制,并为开发基于微生物群的生物标志物和微生态干预措施以预防非宫颈HPV相关恶性肿瘤提供了理论支持。

papers.title: In vitro and insilico antiviral activity of Polyscias scutellaria leaf extract against drug-susceptible and drug-resistant herpes simplex virus and human papillomavirus-positive cervical cancer: implications for topical formulation development.
papers.abstract: Herpes simplex virus (HSV) and human papillomavirus (HPV) infections remain major global health concerns, particularly in immunocompromised individuals. Herbal extracts have emerged as promising candidates for developing novel antiviral agents, particularly against drug-resistant viruses. This study examined the inhibitory effects of Polyscias scutellaria (Burm.f.) Fosberg, a tropical ornamental plant with edible young shoots and leaves against HSV, HPV, and cervical cancer cell growth. Four extracts prepared from fresh and dried leaves using ethanolic and hot-water methods were evaluated for their inhibitory activities against drug-susceptible and drug-resistant HSV and HPV, as well as for their effects on CaSki and HeLa cell growth, using plaque inhibition, HPV-16 pseudovirus binding, wound-healing, acridine/ethidium dual staining, and flow cytometry assays. Gene and protein expression levels were analyzed by quantitative qPCR and western blot analysis. The ethanolic extract of fresh P. scutellaria exhibited the strongest inhibitory effects against both wild-type and drug-resistant HSV strains among all extracts tested and downregulated HSV-1 ICP4, UL30, US6 and gC. This extract also suppressed HPV-16 pseudovirus infection at an early stage. In addition, it reduced cancer cell proliferation and increased apoptosis, while suppressing HPV-16/18 E6, BCL2, and NFKB1 expression and upregulating BAX expression. The putatively annotated metabolites with the highest peak area in P. scutellaria identified using electrospray ionization-quadrupole time-of-flight mass spectrometry, showed favorable drug-likeness and potential interactions with candidate HSV-1 and HPV-16 proteins by in silico analysis. Notably, a prototype herbal soap containing this extract significantly reduced drug-resistant HSV-1 infection and HPV-16/18 E6 expression. These findings highlight P. scutellaria as a promising natural antiviral and anticancer agent with potential for health-product development.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the antiviral activity of Polyscias scutellaria leaf extract against herpes simplex virus (HSV) and human papillomavirus (HPV), particularly in drug-resistant strains and HPV-associated cervical cancer. The research aimed to explore the potential of this plant extract as a topical formulation for antiviral and anticancer applications. The study evaluated four extracts using various assays, including plaque inhibition, HPV-16 pseudovirus binding, and flow cytometry, and found that the ethanolic extract of fresh leaves had the strongest inhibitory effects against HSV and suppressed HPV-16 pseudovirus infection. It also reduced cancer cell proliferation and increased apoptosis. The findings suggest that P. scutellaria could be a promising natural agent for developing health products targeting HSV and HPV infections. However, the study is limited to in vitro and in silico analyses, and further research is needed to validate these results in vivo.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 单纯疱疹病毒(HSV)和人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染仍然是全球主要的健康问题,特别是在免疫功能低下的人群中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了Polyscias scutellaria(Burm.f.)Fosberg这种热带观赏植物,其嫩芽和嫩叶可食用,对HSV、HPV以及宫颈癌细胞生长的抑制作用。
elements_zh.methods: 采用乙醇和热水法从新鲜和干燥的叶片中制备的四种提取物,通过斑块抑制、HPV-16假病毒结合、伤口愈合、吖啶/溴化乙锭双染色和流式细胞术检测其对药物敏感型和药物耐受型HSV和HPV的抑制活性,以及对CaSki和HeLa细胞生长的影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 新鲜P. scutellaria的乙醇提取物在所有测试提取物中对野生型和药物耐受型HSV株表现出最强的抑制作用,并下调了HSV-1的ICP4、UL30、US6和gC。该提取物还抑制了HPV-16假病毒在早期阶段的感染。此外,它减少了癌细胞增殖并增加了细胞凋亡,同时抑制了HPV-16/18 E6、BCL2和NFKB1的表达,上调了BAX的表达。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 通过定量qPCR和Western blot分析检测基因和蛋白表达水平。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 通过电喷雾离子化-四极杆飞行时间质谱法鉴定出P. scutellaria中具有最高峰面积的潜在代谢物,显示出良好的类药物特性,并通过计算机模拟分析显示出与候选HSV-1和HPV-16蛋白的潜在相互作用。含有该提取物的原型草本香皂显著降低了耐药型HSV-1感染和HPV-16/18 E6的表达。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些发现突显了P. scutellaria作为有前景的天然抗病毒药物和抗癌剂的潜力,具有开发健康产品的前景。

papers.title: Awareness and attitudes of health and non-health faculty students at the University of Split, Croatia about human papillomavirus vaccination: a cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Awareness, vaccine-related behavior, and perceptions about the human papillomavirus (HPV) vary in certain higher education student populations in Croatia in the context of low HPV vaccination rates. These factors concerning HPV and vaccination in higher education students in diverse fields would inform public health officials about interventions to improve non-vaccination. We aimed to evaluate HPV and HPV vaccine knowledge, perceptions, and behavior of health and non-health students in Split, Croatia. In a cross-sectional survey, we purposively approached students at the University of Split enrolled in health-related and non-health-related programs from March to April 2024. We used a survey with 29 dichotomous (yes/no) and Likert-scale items in English. The survey requested sociodemographic characteristics (12 items), HPV awareness (8 items), and perceptions and attitude (4 items) and behavioral intentions toward HPV vaccination (3 items). We used Chi-square test to compare frequencies and binomial logistic regression in unadjusted and adjusted models to explore associations of sociodemographic variables (unadjusted models only) and knowledge, perception, and behavior variables, HPV vaccination status, intention to be vaccinated, and study program. Of the 463 students who participated in the survey, 256 (55%) were health studies students. Of these, 361 (78%) were female and 287 (62%) were first-year students. Two hundred and thirty-four (91.4%) health studies students compared to 178 (86.0%) non-health studies students were aware of the HPV vaccine, while high proportions of health (98.4%) and non-health (95.7%) students heard about HPV. Non-health studies students reported higher uncertainty about HPV as a cause of cancer (odds ratio [OR] 2.29, 95% CI 1.17–4.47) and anogenital cancer (4.03, 95% CI 2.17–7.50). Less than one-third ( n = 123/463, 27%) of the students self-reported being vaccinated against HPV. Not wanting to seek more information about the vaccine (OR 0.10, 95% CI 0.05–0.21) was associated with not intending to get vaccinated, similarly not knowing family or friends’ vaccination status was associated with self-reported non-vaccination (OR 0.26, 95% CI 0.16–0.42) and not intending to get vaccinated (OR 0.17, 95% CI 0.09–0.34). Although most students were not vaccinated, many students’ awareness was high about HPV and the HPV vaccine. analysis.methods: The study used a survey with 29 dichotomous (yes/no) and Likert-scale items in English. Chi-square tests were used to compare frequencies, and binomial logistic regression was applied in unadjusted and adjusted models to explore associations.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed HPV awareness, perceptions, and vaccination behaviors among health and non-health students at the University of Split, Croatia. The survey, conducted from March to April 2024, included 29 items measuring knowledge, attitudes, and behavioral intentions. Results showed that 91.4% of health students and 86.0% of non-health students were aware of the HPV vaccine, while less than one-third (27%) reported being vaccinated. Non-health students exhibited higher uncertainty about HPV's role in cancer and were more likely to not intend vaccination if they lacked information. The study highlights the importance of addressing information gaps in HPV vaccination campaigns, particularly among non-health students. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the cross-sectional design and reliance on self-reported data, but the statistical methods used support the findings.
